messages:
nina chen: quick heads-up — Datadog asked for a compact 'telemetry sample hub' we can hand to SI partners. they want OTLP -> dd pipeline + dashboard templates and a 10min demo. can we scope this? :eyes:
ben park: ok. what are acceptance criteria from their side? ingest success + dashboards rendering? any perf targets?
kai o'connor: suggest a small repo called telemetry-sample-hub with: 1) otlp replay script and sample payloads, 2) otel-collector config that exports to Datadog API, 3) terraform module that creates a demo DD tile/dashboard, 4) short demo script + runbook.
nina chen: + privacy: examples must not contain real keys or customer data. include KMS placeholders and a note for private deployments to swap in local exporters. partnerships will own the partner README and walkthrough video.
ben park: timeline? partner kickoff demo is 2026-04-07, so we'd like a dry-run by 04/03. tight but possible if we scope a v1 minimal artifact.
kai o'connor: I'll take eng ownership of the otel-collector config and replay tooling. proposed repo layout in one-liner:
```
/examples/otlp-replay/  # node/python replay scripts + sample pbls
/deploy/terraform/     # dd dashboards + api key placeholder
/collector/            # otelcol yaml + dd exporter config
/ci/                   # replay pipeline (github actions)
/docs/                 # partner README + demo script
```
ben park: add a sample curl example for partners to test quickly. something like:
```
curl -X POST \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  http://localhost:4318/v1/traces \
  --data @sample-trace.json
```
nina chen: include a checklist for the partner ops handoff: ingest verified, dashboards load within 5s, sample traces show service/latency tags, runbook with rollback notes, and a privacy checklist.
kai o'connor: noted. engineering will include sample trace attributes we want partners to use (service, span.kind, rw_latency_ms, model.name). also will add KV cache and batch-size hints in doc so customers can validate perf heuristics.
ben park: i'll draft the acceptance checklist and partner email template. also add a short 'don't use in prod' SLA blurb in README.
deploy-bot: staging cluster provisioned: partner-demo-1743219999 (k8s: demo-ns, otelcol pods 2/2) :rocket:
ben park: sweet, I'll schedule a dry-run with Datadog PO for 04/01. nina — can partnerships produce the walkthrough video by 04/02?
nina chen: yep, we can do a 3-4 min demo clip and a longer 10min walkthrough. i'll coordinate with growth for captions.
kai o'connor: i'll open GH repo and PR base skeleton by EOD today, will tag @ben and @nina for review.
ben park: :thumbsup: sounds good. we'll keep the v1 scope minimal and iterate post-demo.
nina chen: thanks team — i'll post this as an action item doc in Notion and link the repo when it's up.
